_about: Skills the Warden can learn from a trainer for coins. `craft`: a skill with recipes (recipes.json) names its crafting window, the verb in the log, its button and where you must stand. `teaches`: abilities that appear in the spellbook once learned. `maxRank`: skills that improve with use (fishing rises with each catch, cooking with each dish that is not yet easy for you).

skills.name: Camping
skills.desc: Pitch a camp anywhere quiet. Your spirit rises there if you fall, resting by it builds rested experience, and Return to Camp brings you back to it.

skills.name: Fishing
skills.desc: Cast a line into still water and strike when the bob dips. Rises with every catch.

skills.name: Lockpicking
skills.desc: Open locked chests without their key (you need lockpicks). Each lock needs a certain rank; every lock you pick raises it.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.desc: Cook fish and meat at a fire (a camp or the inn's hearth). Grilled perch and roast dace come with the skill; Hester teaches more as you improve. Rises as you cook.

craft.station: a fire: your camp or a hearth

skills.name: Skinning
skills.desc: Skin the beasts you kill for their hides and pelts (you need a skinning knife). Loot the body first, then skin it. Higher-level beasts need a higher rank (5 ranks a level); the skill rises with every skin that is not yet easy for you.

skills.name: Mining
skills.desc: Mine the ore veins that glint in rock outcrops (you need a mining pick), and smelt ore into bars at a forge. Veins move: a mined-out outcrop goes bare and another in the same group starts to glint. Harder rock needs a higher rank (5 ranks an ore level); the skill rises with every swing that is not yet easy for you, and as you smelt.
